📝 Logs API

Structured log data ingestion and search with OpenTelemetry protocol

Base URL

{{.BaseURL}}/v1/logs

Endpoints

POST /v1/logs

Ingest log records using OpenTelemetry protocol

Headers

Content-Type: application/x-protobuf
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>

Request Body

OpenTelemetry ExportLogsServiceRequest protobuf message

{
  "resource_logs": [{
    "resource": {
      "attributes": [
        {"key": "service.name", "value": {"string_value": "my-service"}},
        {"key": "service.version", "value": {"string_value": "1.0.0"}}
      ]
    },
    "scope_logs": [{
      "scope": {
        "name": "my-logger",
        "version": "1.0.0"
      },
      "log_records": [{
        "time_unix_nano": "1640995200000000000",
        "severity_number": "SEVERITY_NUMBER_ERROR",
        "severity_text": "ERROR",
        "body": {
          "string_value": "Failed to process request"
        },
        "attributes": [
          {"key": "http.method", "value": {"string_value": "POST"}},
          {"key": "http.status_code", "value": {"int_value": "500"}},
          {"key": "error.message", "value": {"string_value": "Database connection timeout"}},
          {"key": "user.id", "value": {"string_value": "12345"}}
        ],
        "trace_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
        "span_id": "0123456789abcdef"
      }]
    }]
  }]
}

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "partial_success": {
    "rejected_log_records": 0,
    "error_message": ""
  }
}

GET /v1/logs/search

Search and filter log records

Query Parameters

  • query - Search query (Lucene-like syntax)
  • start - Start time (RFC3339)
  • end - End time (RFC3339)
  • severity - Filter by severity level
  • service - Filter by service name
  • trace_id - Filter by trace ID
  • limit - Result limit (max 10,000, default 1,000)
  • offset - Pagination offset
  • sort - Sort order: timestamp_asc, timestamp_desc (default)

Example Search Query

GET /v1/logs/search?query=error.message:"timeout" AND http.status_code:500&start=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z&end=2024-01-01T23:59:59Z&limit=100

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "logs": [{
    "timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:00.123456789Z",
    "severity": "ERROR",
    "message": "Failed to process request",
    "service": "my-service",
    "trace_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    "span_id": "0123456789abcdef",
    "attributes": {
      "http.method": "POST",
      "http.status_code": 500,
      "error.message": "Database connection timeout",
      "user.id": "12345"
    }
  }],
  "total": 1547,
  "has_more": true
}

GET /v1/logs/tail

Real-time log streaming with Server-Sent Events

Query Parameters

  • query - Filter query for streaming logs
  • service - Filter by service name
  • severity - Minimum severity level

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive

data: {"timestamp":"2024-01-01T12:00:01Z","severity":"INFO","message":"Request processed","service":"my-service"}

data: {"timestamp":"2024-01-01T12:00:02Z","severity":"ERROR","message":"Failed to connect","service":"my-service"}

GET /v1/logs/aggregate

Aggregate log data by time intervals and fields

Query Parameters

  • query - Filter query
  • start - Start time
  • end - End time
  • interval - Time interval (e.g., "1m", "5m", "1h")
  • group_by - Fields to group by (comma-separated)
  • function - Aggregation function: count, avg, sum, min, max

Example

GET /v1/logs/aggregate?query=severity:ERROR&start=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z&end=2024-01-01T23:59:59Z&interval=1h&group_by=service&function=count

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "buckets": [{
    "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "groups": {
      "my-service": 15,
      "auth-service": 8,
      "payment-service": 3
    }
  }, {
    "timestamp": "2024-01-01T01:00:00Z",
    "groups": {
      "my-service": 12,
      "auth-service": 5,
      "payment-service": 1
    }
  }]
}

Query Syntax

Field Search

field:value
service:"my-service"
http.status_code:500

Boolean Operators

severity:ERROR AND service:"payment"
severity:ERROR OR severity:WARN
NOT severity:DEBUG

Range Queries

http.status_code:[400 TO 499]
timestamp:[2024-01-01T00:00:00Z TO 2024-01-01T23:59:59Z]

Wildcards

message:*timeout*
service:auth-*
error.message:connection?failed

Regular Expressions

message:/error|fail|exception/i
user.id:/user-\d+/

Severity Levels

TRACE (1-4)

Fine-grained informational events

DEBUG (5-8)

Debug-level messages

INFO (9-12)

Informational messages

WARN (13-16)

Warning conditions

ERROR (17-20)

Error conditions

FATAL (21-24)

Fatal error conditions

Rate Limits

  • Ingestion: 1,000,000 log records/second per API key
  • Search: 100 requests/minute per API key
  • Streaming: 10 concurrent connections per API key
  • Batch size: Maximum 100,000 log records per request
